title: Travel-Issue Nightly Refund Settlement Where Rewards Credits Paid Part of a Stay
content:
# Finance settlement note — travel-issue nightly refund on a stay partly paid with Roamhaven Rewards credits

**Rule.** When Roamhaven Rewards credits paid part of a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category, the credit-funded part of the travel-issue nightly refund goes back as credits and only the rest is paid to the card: when credits were redeemed on the stay and none of them has been reinstated yet, the card receives the travel-issue nightly refund times one minus the credits redeemed divided by the stay's total price; when credits were redeemed on the stay and part of them has already been reinstated, the card receives it times one minus the credits still outstanding (redeemed less reinstated) divided by the stay's total price; otherwise, including when no credits were redeemed, the card receives the whole travel-issue nightly refund. The credit-funded part is taken out before the refund is rounded half up to the cent once.

The credits redeemed on the stay and reinstated on it are read from the guest's Roamhaven Rewards ledger; the total price is the one recorded on the stay.

## Worked (hypothetical: total price 4,000.00, nightly amount 750.00 before the split)

1. 1,000.00 redeemed, none reinstated: card share one minus 0.25, that is 0.75; card part 562.50.
2. 1,000.00 redeemed, 400.00 reinstated: outstanding 600.00; card share 0.85; card part 637.50.
3. No credits redeemed: card part 750.00.
